wci.outlook: Drewry expects Transpacific rates to decrease further next week despite ten announced blank sailings, while Asia-Europe/Med rates are expected to rise in the coming weeks as December demand strengthens ahead of the new contract season. Many carriers have announced peak season surcharges (PSS) of $1,000-1,600 per 40ft container on Asia-Europe/Med effective December.

ESALG.notes: Only one Algeciras-related THC figure was found: EUR 260 per container for both 20ft and 40ft dry export, taken from a Maersk notice for Algeciras to Newark, US, effective 1 March 2025. It is a corridor origin charge rather than a local tariff, and it is roughly 21 to 22 months old, so it is not current. No import THC was found; the USD destination figures in the notice relate to the US side and do not apply to imports into Algeciras. The Hapag-Lloyd June 2026 THC sheet does not show which port each row covers, so no figure is attributed to Algeciras. No ISPS, documentation, port, infrastructure or EU ETS charges for Algeciras were found. Free days are unresolved: the Maersk Spain import page gives conflicting readings of 7 days or 5 days for dry containers, and it is undated. No daily storage rate was found there. The Hapag-Lloyd Spain storage sheet from October 2024 is about 25 months old and its column layout is unclear, so its possible reading of 7 free days, EUR 40 and EUR 55 has not been used. Current Algeciras rates should be obtained from the terminal operators, including APM Terminals Algeciras, and from the carriers in use, with validity dates confirmed.
